name: Idle Internet Cafe Tycoon
summary:
Your uncle's failing back-alley internet cafe is yours now. Open with six seats, buy gear, place it where it earns, and hire staff to keep the shop running in this cozy management tycoon. One decision repeats throughout: buy gear, which earns forever once bought, or hire staff, who cost a daily wage but keep the shop from grinding to a halt.

Placement is profit. Ramen cookers and vending machines sell more the closer they sit to the seats, a blocked aisle makes a spot dead, and each machine levels up individually, with better seats attracting better-paying guests. Successive stages take the shop from the back alley to nationwide, and the story with your uncle continues at every stage.
